items.name: Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw 2024
items.information: Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję zawodów Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw! W tym roku najlepsi polscy i zagraniczni speedcuberzy będą rywalizować w bardziej popularnych konkurencjach, choć nie zabraknie side'owych akcentów. Wydarzenie odbywa się w [Pałacu Kultury i Nauki](https://pkin.pl/) - jednym z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych miejsc w Polsce. Na zwycięzców czekają nagrody finansowe zapewnione przez [Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem](https://www.szansadlaniewidomych.org/). Turniej organizowany jest przez Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem wraz ze [Stowarzyszeniem Liga Niezwykłych](https://liganiezwyklych.pl/). Wydarzenie finansowane jest ze środków [Miasta Stołecznego Warszawy](https://um.warszawa.pl/) oraz [Mazowsza](https://mazowsze.waw.pl/). Marszałek województwa mazowieckiego [Adam Struzik](https://mazovia.pl/pl/bip/zarzad/sklad-zarzadu/adam-struzik.html) objął wydarzenie swoim patronatem. Na konkurencję **3x3x3 Najmniejsza liczba ruchów** obowiązuje oddzielny limit zawodników: **Najlepsze 30** osób według średniej (lub pojedynczego wyniku) na podstawie zawodników zarejestrowanych. --- We invite you to the fourth edition of the Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw competition! This year, the best Polish and international cubers will compete in the more popular events, though there will be some side events as well. The event will take place in the Palace of Culture and Science - one of the most recognizable buildings in Poland. Financial prizes for the winners are provided by the Chance Foundation - We Are Together. The tournament is organized by the Szansa Foundation - We Are Together along with the Stowarzyszenie Liga Niezwykłych. The event is funded by the City of Warsaw and Mazovia. The Marshal of the Mazowieckie Voivodeship, Adam Struzik, has taken the event under his patronage. For **FMC** event there is a seperate competitor limit: **Top 30** people classified by mean (otherwise single) according to the psych sheet of the registered competitors. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYwNDksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c6e10f78d18761d23d665d7aa7448d5615b396be/unnamed.jpg)

Wydarzenie odbywa się w [Pałacu Kultury i Nauki](https://pkin.pl/) - jednym z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych miejsc w Polsce. Na zwycięzców czekają nagrody finansowe zapewnione przez [Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem](https://www.szansadlaniewidomych.org/). items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBanRsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8851b128ff61a6bb28978995f5697786968a1d08/EZVV3qA.png) Welcome to TahimiKubing in MultiLupa 2024, the first speedcubing competition in Muntinlupa City! Rather than most standard competitions, this competition features **all Blindfolded events (3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-blind), Fewest Moves Challenge, and Clock**, with **3x3 Multi-blind** as the main event. Considering the nature of these events, competitors and spectators are required to remain silent during ongoring rounds. **There also is no regular 3x3 in the competition**. If you are looking for a more typical competition experience, feel free to check out [other competitions happening in the Philippines.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Philippines&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) We also highly discourage competitors from only registering for Clock. **IMPORTANT NOTES:** • Given the venue's size limitations, **competitors are strictly required to bring a maximum of one guest**. Please consider coming without a guest as the venue's accommodation size is limited. • **If you are planning to attempt 10 or more cubes in 3x3 Multi-Blind, please contact the organizers ahead of time so that we can accommodate your attempt logistically.** This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHBrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3598f6ea0dfd471e57f75f334975512ed07158cf/BCD44wd.png)

items.name: Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026
items.information: Välkomna till Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! **Notera att tävlingen hålls i Bergshamra utanför Norrtälje, inte Bergshamra norr om centrala Stockholm!** Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** Grenarna 6x6x6, 7x7x7 och Megaminx kan **inte** kombineras med grenarna 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD. Detta innebär att du exempelvis **inte** kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 3x3x3 BLD, men att du kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 7x7x7. **OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten. ----- Welcome to Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **NOTE:** The 6x6x6, 7x7x7 and Megaminx events **can not** be combined with the 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD events. This means that, for example, you **can not** enter both Megaminx and 3x3x3 BLD, but you can enter both Megaminx and 7x7x7. **NOTE:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Tårnby Cube Træf 2018
items.information: Tårnby Cube Træf er tilbage i 2018! Der vil være alle decipliner pånær 2x2, skewb og pyraminx. Deltagerprisen er inklusiv en T-shirt og generelle udgifter for konkurrencen. Det er muligt at sove på konkurrencestedet fredag- og lørdag nat. Der er en deltager grænse på 90. Siden registreringen endnu ikke er fuld, godtager vi registreringer på dagen, indtil vi når grænsen på 90 deltagere. Se registrering og betalings fanen for mere info. --- Tårnby Cube Træf is back for 2018! We will be hosting all events apart from 2x2, skewb, and pyraminx. Registration costs include a competition T-shirt and general costs toward the competition. It is possible to sleep at the venue on Friday and Saturday night. The competitor limit is 90. Since the registration has not been filled we will accept registrations on-site until we get to 90 competitors. See the registration and payment tab.

items.name: Tårnby Cube Træf 2019
items.information: Dette er den 3. version af Tårnby Cube Træf. Udover officielle WCA dicsipliner kommer der også til at blive afholdt fire uofficielle discipliner: Kilominx, TeamBLD, re-scramble, og dodgeball cubing i løbet af weekenden. Det står i tidsskemaet, hvornår de vil foregå! Hvis du tilmelder dig Kilominx på eller før d. 20. oktober vil du modtage en gratis Kilominx fra konkurrencens sponsor, Kube Ninja! ---- This is the 3rd edition of Tårnby Cube Træf. In addition to WCA-reocgnized events, there will also be 4 unofficial events: Kilominx, TeamBLD, re-scramble, and dodgeball cubing at different times in the weekend, see the schedule for when these will be held! If you register for Kilominx on or before October 20th, you will receive a free Kilominx from the competition sponsor, Kube Ninja!

items.information: Kui olete **vähemalt 12-aastane**, peate esitama ühe järgmisest kahest dokumendist: 1. Covid-19 vastase vaktsineerimise tõendi, kusjuures vaktsineerimiskuur peab olema lõpetatud; 2. Covid-19 läbipõdemise tõendi, kusjuures positiivne testitulemus peab olema saadud viimase kuue kuu jooksul; Võistlejad/külalised, kes on **12-17 aasta vanused**, võivad selle asemel esitada negatiivse PCR testi tulemuse (mitte vanem kui 72 h) või negatiivse antigeeni kiirtesti tulemuse (mitte vanem kui 48 h), kusjuures testi peab olema läbi viinud meditsiinitöötaja - tulemus peab kajastuma Digiloos. Võistluspaigas on maskikandmine **kohustuslik**. --- If you are **at least 12 years old**, after arriving at the venue you must present one of the following: 1. Proof of vaccination against Covid-19. Vaccination has to be completed; 2. Proof that you have recovered from Covid-19. The positive test result must be newer than six months; Alternatively, competitors/guests who are **12 to 17 years old** may present a negative result from either a PCR test (no older than 72h) or an antigen test (no older than 48h) (tests performed by a medical professional). Wearing a mask at the competition venue is **mandatory**. ![Eesti kuubik](https://i.imgur.com/Cr7XSizt.png)

venue.details: Quadra de Esportes de frente a rua

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos o primeiro Tatu Open Curitiba! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). É muito importante que você conheça o regulamento, que pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. Inscrições na hora do evento serão aceitas somente para a modalidade 3x3x3 É importante chegar pelo menos meia hora antes das categorias que for participar para relizar o check in. Lembrando que se for sua primeira competição, você irá precisar levar um documento com foto. **English** It is with great joy that we announce the first Tatu Open Curitiba! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner (first competition)', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event. Registrations during the competition will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 event. It is important to arrive half an hour before the events you'll participate in to do the check-in. Also remember that if this is your first competition, you'll need to bring a photo ID.

items.name: Tauranga Open 2023
items.information: Tauranga Open 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: [GE] გთხოვთ, სახელი და გვარი შეავსოთ ზუსტად ისე როგორც მოცემულია თქვენს პირადობის დამადასტურებელ საბუთში. ინგლისურად შევსებისას, სახელის და გვარის პირველი ასო ჩაწერეთ დიდი ასოებით. პირადობის დამადასტურებელი საბუთი თან იქონიეთ შეჯიბრზე გამოცხადებისას. სტუმრის რაოდენობა შეზღუდულია (1 მონაწილეს შესაძლებელია თან ახლდეს მაქსიმუმ 1 გულშემატკივარი) - გულშემატკივრის დასწრების საფასური 10 ლ [EN] Please enter your name and surname during registration as it is writter on your ID. The First letters are capital letters. Dont forget to have an ID card with you when you come to the competition Here is Guest limitation (1 guest for each competitor) - 10 GEL for guest

items.name: Teknostallen 2026
items.information: ### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026 Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder. Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede. Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. --- ### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026 Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests. The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy. Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. There will be great opportunities to purchase food and drinks from the various venues in the building, including Mellom, Glød and Snurr.

items.information: **Note:** Competitors under the age of 18 must fill out this [form](https://forms.gle/cFt7i8vmK9yEA7U2A) and be accompanied by an adult parent/guardian at all times. Join us for a short competition on the same day as [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026)! This competition will **not** hold the 3x3x3 speedsolving event, but it is a great way to achieve qualifying times for the Southeast and North American Championship or get some extra solves in for less commonly held events. Southeast FMC Championship will be held from 10AM-2PM at the same location; if you are not competing in FMC, you are not obligated to stay at the competition during those hours. However, if you want to compete in FMC, you must sign up for that competition separately. items.name: The Art of the Cube Colorado 2023
items.information: # **PLEASE READ THE MUSEUM ADMISSION TAB** We're excited to welcome competitors back to Denver for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! * **This competition has a 105 competitor limit.** * Please Only Bring Two Guests * Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition,[ this video ](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)will provide you with most of the information you need. * If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM. * **If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team**, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of October 7, 6:00 PM MDT. This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVUvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6b1dbbfb8fde69539bfd38dc36f5ade063103470/image.png)

items.name: The Bahamas Cube Challenge 2026
items.information: The first WCA competition in the Bahamas! #### This competition will serve as the 2026 Bahamas National Championship. The fastest Bahamian competitor in the 3x3 event will be crowned the National Champion of the Bahamas. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. The competition is open to all competitors of all ages and nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/).

venue.name: Western Development Museum North Battleford
venue.address: SK-16 &, SK-40, North Battleford, SK S9A 2Y1

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png) **Western Development Museum: The registration fee for this competition includes admission to the Western Development Museum for the competitors and their guests.** There will be a longer lunch break in the competition schedule so everyone can enjoy the museum. Learn more about the WDM at their website [here](https://wdm.ca/north-battleford/). We ask attendees to limit themselves to two guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 240 people. Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in. First Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition. Draw prizes: There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done. Notice of Filming and Photography: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. Esta competição será realizada em um formato diferente do tradicional, neste campeonato, os competidores terão uma hora de limite para fazer todos os eventos que quiserem na ordem em que desejarem. Em um grupo serão juízes, no outro, competidores e em outro, embaralhadores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners This competition will happen in a format different from the traditional, at this competition, the competitors will have an hour to do all the events they want in the order they want. In a group they will be judges, on the other, competitors and in a last one, scramblers.

items.information: Three Rounds Whangarei 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Tirol Open 2019
items.information: 2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol! Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte. Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab! ______ 2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol! Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well. The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

items.information: 東北大会2018は，山形県初のWCA公式大会です。これまでに東北大会は仙台にて2回開催されましたが，今年は山形キューブ会([Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/rubirubi3x3x3/))が中心となって山形での開催となります。 競技は2x2x2～4x4x4，3x3x3目隠し，ピラミンクス，スキューブの6種目で，3x3x3は3ラウンド，2x2x2，4x4x4は2ラウンドの開催となります。芋煮会シーズンの山形に，ぜひお越しください。 Tohoku 2018 is the first competition in Yamagata ever. WCA competitions in Tohoku area have taken place twice in Sendai, this time Yamagata Cubing Club ([Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/rubirubi3x3x3/)) organizes in Yamagata. It has 6 events including 2x2x2, 3x3x3, 4x4x4, 3x3x3 blindfolded, Pyraminx and Skewb (3 rounds for 3x3x3 and 2 rounds for 2x2x2 and 4x4x4.) It will just the season of [Imoni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imoni) events in Yamagata, where you can enjoy traditional local cuisine. Let's enjoy Yamagata and cubing!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbjVvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cbc38cf4292d3456b348ed1c98f9220e790a124c/565a7d59-6eb6-4b27-af6a-ad3bd4963ec0%5B1%5D.png) 「東海チャレンジ2024」の全ての大会は、WCAの「ニューカマー月間2024」(WCA Newcomer Month 2024)の適用大会です。 詳細は、[WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024#40601-wca-newcomer-month) のタブをご覧ください。 ### WCAシリーズ大会 「東海チャレンジ2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「東海チャレンジ2024」の「アルファ大会」のページです。 ・ Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024(**本ページでは「アルファ大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokai Challenge Beta 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeBeta2024) (**本ページでは「ベータ大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeGamma2024)(**本ページでは「ガンマ大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・アルファ大会：3x3x3 のみ 1 ラウンド 開場時刻 9:00 定員40名 ・ベータ大会：3x3x3 のみ 1 ラウンド 開場時刻 13:00 定員40名 ・ガンマ大会：クロック のみ 2 ラウンド 開場時刻 16:00 定員20名 ガンマ大会終了後にTSCスペースを開催します。 ・スピードキューバーのためのオフ会です。 ・交流、親睦、情報交換を楽しんでください。 ・18:30開始、20:00終了を予定しています。 ### 注意 注意１．来場時刻について アルファ大会については、時間厳守でお願いします。 ベータ大会、ガンマ大会については、時間に余裕をもって会場にお越しください。 競技の進行によっては前倒しで進めることがあります。 注意２．受付について 受付はありません。 必ず事前にご自身の役割（競技者、ジャッジ、スクランブラ）を確認してください。 会場に到着しましたら、速やかに観客席に着席してください。 ### 「東海チャレンジ」のコンセプト 「東海チャレンジ」では、できるだけ多くの方々にWCA大会にチャレンジしていただきたいと思っています。 アルファ大会、ベータ大会、ガンマ大会の違いについて簡単に説明します。 １．アルファ大会とベータ大会 「東海チャレンジ」では、WCA大会初心者の方、WCA大会未経験の方に、WCA大会にチャレンジして頂きたいと思っています。 アルファ大会とベータ大会は、3x3x3のみの1種目、1ラウンドです。 ぜひWCA大会にチャレンジし、大会の雰囲気、大会の楽しさを味わってください。 ２．ガンマ大会 「東海チャレンジ」では、3x3x3以外の種目についてもチャレンジしていただきたいと思っています。 ガンマ大会では、クロックを2ラウンドで開催します。 クロックが好きな方、クロックに自信がある方、クロックで腕試ししたい方は、ぜひチャレンジしてください。 ### 競技参加者以外の来場要件 **限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。** 観客席に着席できない場合は、見学をお断りすることがあります。席を譲り合い、空いている席が無いように詰めてお掛けください。 ### サポーター募集 より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには、大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。 後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。 ### 主催団体TSCとは 東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ（以下 TSC）は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」およびスピードキューバー向けの自己研鑽の場「TSCスペース自習室」をそれぞれ月1回を目標に開催しています。 また、SCJ大会を年4回を目標に、WCA大会を年1回を目標に開催しています。 現在、運営スタッフを募集中です。 一緒にWCA大会やTSCスペースを開催しましょう！ All the competitions in "Tokai Challenge 2024" are applied to the WCA Newcomer Month 2024. For more information, please see the [WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024#40601-wca-newcomer-month) tab. ### WCA Series Competitions Tokai Challenge 2024 is a WCA series competition. WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can participate in **only one** of them. If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page shows Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024. Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024 (**In this page, called "Alpha "**) [Tokai Challenge Beta 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeBeta2024) (**In this page, called "Beta"**) [Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeGamma2024)(**In this page, called "Gamma"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: Alpha : 3x3x3 only, 1 round, open at 9:00, capacity 40 Beta : 3x3x3 only, 1 round, open at 13:00, capacity 40 Gamma : Clock only, 2 rounds, open at 16:00, capacity 20 TSC space will be held after the Gamma competition. This is an off-line meeting for speedcubers. Please enjoy socializing, friendship, and exchanging information. The event starts from 18:30 to 20:00. ### Cautions Caution 1: About the time of arrival Please be on-time arrival for the Alpha. For Beta and Gamma, please arrive at the venue well in advance. Depending on the progress of the competition, it may be moved ahead of schedule. Caution 2: Reception We have no reception desk. Please make sure to confirm your role (competitor, judge, scrambler) in advance. Upon arrival at the venue, please be seated at the spectator's seats as soon as possible. ### Concept of "Tokai Challenge" In the "Tokai Challenge," we want to encourage as many people as possible to try out for the WCA competitions. The following is a brief explanation of the differences between the Alpha, Beta, and Gamma. 1.Alpha and Beta The Tokai Challenge is intended to challenge those who are new to WCA competitions and those who have no experience in WCA competitions. The Alpha and Beta are 3x3x3 only, one event, one round. We encourage you to try the WCA competitions and experience the atmosphere and the fun of the competitions. 2.Gamma In the "Tokai Challenge," we would like to challenge you to compete in events other than 3x3x3. In the Gamma , Clock event will be held in two rounds. If you like Clock, are confident with Clock, or want to test your skills with Clock, please take the challenge. ### Requirements for non-competitors **In order to allow as many competitors as possible to participate in the limited size of the venue, we have set restrictions on accompanying persons and visitors.** If you are unable to be seated in the spectator seating area, we may refuse to allow you to observe. Please be sure to share your seat and pack up and sit down so that there are no empty seats. ### Supporters Wanted In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions. We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date. ### About TSC, the host organization Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as "TSC") holds "TSC Space," an off-line meeting for speedcubers, and "TSC Space Study Room," a place for self-improvement for speedcubers, aiming to hold each once a month. We also aim to hold the SCJ competition four times a year and the WCA competition once a year. We are currently looking for an administrative staff member. Let's organize WCA competitions and TSC space together!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbjVvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cbc38cf4292d3456b348ed1c98f9220e790a124c/565a7d59-6eb6-4b27-af6a-ad3bd4963ec0%5B1%5D.png) 「東海チャレンジ2024」の全ての大会は、WCAの「ニューカマー月間2024」(WCA Newcomer Month 2024)の適用大会です。 詳細は、[WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024#40601-wca-newcomer-month) のタブをご覧ください。 ### WCAシリーズ大会 「東海チャレンジ2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「東海チャレンジ2024」の「ベータ大会」のページです。 ・[Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024)(**本ページでは「アルファ大会」と表記**) ・Tokai Challenge Beta 2024 (**本ページでは「ベータ大会」と表記**) ・[Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeGamma2024)(**本ページでは「ガンマ大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・アルファ大会：3x3x3 のみ 1 ラウンド 開場時刻 9:00 定員40名 ・ベータ大会：3x3x3 のみ 1 ラウンド 開場時刻 13:00 定員40名 ・ガンマ大会：クロック のみ 2 ラウンド 開場時刻 16:00 定員20名 ガンマ大会終了後にTSCスペースを開催します。 ・スピードキューバーのためのオフ会です。 ・交流、親睦、情報交換を楽しんでください。 ・18:30開始、20:00終了を予定しています。 ### 注意 注意１．来場時刻について アルファ大会については、時間厳守でお願いします。 ベータ大会、ガンマ大会については、時間に余裕をもって会場にお越しください。 競技の進行によっては前倒しで進めることがあります。 注意２．受付について 受付はありません。 必ず事前にご自身の役割（競技者、ジャッジ、スクランブラ）を確認してください。 会場に到着しましたら、速やかに観客席に着席してください。 ### 「東海チャレンジ」のコンセプト 「東海チャレンジ」では、できるだけ多くの方々にWCA大会にチャレンジしていただきたいと思っています。 アルファ大会、ベータ大会、ガンマ大会の違いについて簡単に説明します。 １．アルファ大会とベータ大会 「東海チャレンジ」では、WCA大会初心者の方、WCA大会未経験の方に、WCA大会にチャレンジして頂きたいと思っています。 アルファ大会とベータ大会は、3x3x3のみの1種目、1ラウンドです。 ぜひWCA大会にチャレンジし、大会の雰囲気、大会の楽しさを味わってください。 ２．ガンマ大会 「東海チャレンジ」では、3x3x3以外の種目についてもチャレンジしていただきたいと思っています。 ガンマ大会では、クロックを2ラウンドで開催します。 クロックが好きな方、クロックに自信がある方、クロックで腕試ししたい方は、ぜひチャレンジしてください。 ### 競技参加者以外の来場要件 **限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。** 観客席に着席できない場合は、見学をお断りすることがあります。席を譲り合い、空いている席が無いように詰めてお掛けください。 ### サポーター募集 より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには、大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。 後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。 ### 主催団体TSCとは 東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ（以下 TSC）は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」およびスピードキューバー向けの自己研鑽の場「TSCスペース自習室」をそれぞれ月1回を目標に開催しています。 また、SCJ大会を年4回を目標に、WCA大会を年1回を目標に開催しています。 現在、運営スタッフを募集中です。 一緒にWCA大会やTSCスペースを開催しましょう！ All the competitions in "Tokai Challenge 2024" are applied to the WCA Newcomer Month 2024. For more information, please see the [WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024#40601-wca-newcomer-month) tab. ### WCA Series Competitions Tokai Challenge 2024 is a WCA series competition. WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can participate in **only one** of them. If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page shows Tokai Challenge Beta 2024. [Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024 ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024)(**In this page, called "Alpha "**) Tokai Challenge Beta 2024(**In this page, called "Beta"**) [Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeGamma2024)(**In this page, called "Gamma"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: Alpha : 3x3x3 only, 1 round, open at 9:00, capacity 40 Beta : 3x3x3 only, 1 round, open at 13:00, capacity 40 Gamma : Clock only, 2 rounds, open at 16:00, capacity 20 TSC space will be held after the Gamma competition. This is an off-line meeting for speedcubers. Please enjoy socializing, friendship, and exchanging information. The event starts from 18:30 to 20:00. ### Cautions Caution 1: About the time of arrival Please be on-time arrival for the Alpha. For Beta and Gamma, please arrive at the venue well in advance. Depending on the progress of the competition, it may be moved ahead of schedule. Caution 2: Reception We have no reception desk. Please make sure to confirm your role (competitor, judge, scrambler) in advance. Upon arrival at the venue, please be seated at the spectator's seats as soon as possible. ### Concept of "Tokai Challenge" In the "Tokai Challenge," we want to encourage as many people as possible to try out for the WCA competitions. The following is a brief explanation of the differences between the Alpha, Beta, and Gamma. 1.Alpha and Beta The Tokai Challenge is intended to challenge those who are new to WCA competitions and those who have no experience in WCA competitions. The Alpha and Beta are 3x3x3 only, one event, one round. We encourage you to try the WCA competitions and experience the atmosphere and the fun of the competitions. 2.Gamma In the "Tokai Challenge," we would like to challenge you to compete in events other than 3x3x3. In the Gamma , Clock event will be held in two rounds. If you like Clock, are confident with Clock, or want to test your skills with Clock, please take the challenge. ### Requirements for non-competitors **In order to allow as many competitors as possible to participate in the limited size of the venue, we have set restrictions on accompanying persons and visitors.** If you are unable to be seated in the spectator seating area, we may refuse to allow you to observe. Please be sure to share your seat and pack up and sit down so that there are no empty seats. ### Supporters Wanted In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions. We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date. ### About TSC, the host organization Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as "TSC") holds "TSC Space," an off-line meeting for speedcubers, and "TSC Space Study Room," a place for self-improvement for speedcubers, aiming to hold each once a month. We also aim to hold the SCJ competition four times a year and the WCA competition once a year. We are currently looking for an administrative staff member. Let's organize WCA competitions and TSC space together!

items.information: 東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ(以下 TSC)は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」を定期的に開催しており、2023年9月に100回目の開催を迎えます。これを記念し、第100回TSCスペース記念大会を開催します。 今大会は受付時間を設けておりません。参加される競技に合わせてお越しください。競技の進行によっては時間を前倒しで進めますので余裕をもってお越しください。 今大会終了後に第100回TSCスペースを開催します。詳細は[第100回TSCスペース記念サイト](https://100th.cubing.nagoya/)をご覧ください。 Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as TSC) has been holding off-line meetings for speedcubers called "TSC Space" on a regular basis and will celebrate its 100th meeting in September 2023. To commemorate this event, The 100th TSC Space Memorial competition will be held. No check-in is required at the competition day. Please come according to the competition you will be participating in. Depending on the progress of the competition, it may be ahead of schedule, so please ensure to arrive in plenty of time. The 100th TSC Space will be held after this competition. For more information, please visit [the 100th TSC Space Commemorative Website](https://100th.cubing.nagoya/).

items.information: ### WCAシリーズ大会 「東海大会2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「東海大会2024」の「AM大会」のページです。 ・ Tokai Open AM 2024(**本ページでは「AM大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokai Open PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiOpenPM2024) (**本ページでは「PM大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、3x3x3 片手 2ラウンド 開場時刻 9:00 定員72名 ・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、5x5x5 キューブ 2ラウンド 開場時刻 13:30 定員72名 ### 来場時刻 AM大会については、必ず受付時間内にお越しください。 PM大会については、開場時刻の13:30までは会場に入れません。なるべく13:30から13:50の間にお越しください。 ### 参加費の支払い方法 参加費は受付時にお支払いください。 支払い方法は現金のみです。 ### 同伴、見学について 同伴は競技者一人につき**2名まで**とします。申込時に同伴者数を入力してください。 大会見学希望の方へ。 観客席に僅かですが空席が生じることが分かりましたので、見学希望者の方はメールに、以下内容の記載をお願いします。 送信先：comp@cubing.nagoya メールタイトル： 【WCA東海大会】見学希望 メール本文： ・希望人数：〇名 ・全員の氏名：例 山田太郎、山田次郎 ・見学したい大会：AM、PM なお、先着順となりますので、ご了承ください。 **連絡無しの見学は絶対におやめください。** ### 当日スタッフ募集 大会を円滑に進めるために、実行委員以外のスタッフを募集します。当日スタッフにはジャッジ、スクランブラ、ランナーにご協力頂きたいと思います。 後日、当日スタッフ募集についてご案内します。 ### 主催団体「TSC」とは 東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ（以下 TSC）は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」およびスピードキューバー向けの自己研鑽の場「TSCスペース自習室」を開催しています。 現在、運営スタッフを募集中です。 一緒にWCA大会やTSCスペースを開催しましょう！ ### WCA Series Competitions Tokai Open 2024 is a WCA series competition. WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can participate in **only one** of them. If you apply for more than one in the same series, only the one with the earliest application time will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page shows Tokai Open AM 2024. Tokai Open AM 2024 (**In this page, called "AM"**) [Tokai Open PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiOpenPM2024) (**In this page, called "PM"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: AM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 3x3x3 One-Handed 2 rounds, open at 9:00, limit of competitors 72 PM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 5x5x5 Cube 2 rounds, open at 13:30, limit of competitors 72 ### Time of arrival For the AM competition, please be sure to arrive during the reception time. For the PM competition, you will not be allowed to enter the venue until 13:30, the time the doors open. Please arrive between 13:30 and 13:50 if possible. ### How to pay the participation fee Please pay the participation fee at the reception. Payment must be made in cash only. ### Requirements for non-competitors Each competitor may bring up to two people. Please declare the number of guests at registration form. For those who wish to visit. We would like to release a few empty seats in the spectators area, so if you wish to visit, please send us an e-mail with the following information. Send to: comp@cubing.nagoya Mail title: [WCA Tokai Open] visiting request Mail body: Number of people: Name of all visitor: e.g. Taro Yamada, Jiro Yamada Competition to be visited: AM, PM Seats will be available on a first-come, first-served basis with this email. **Please do not visit without notification. ** ### Staff Wanted on the Day In order to ensure the smooth running of the event, we are looking for staff members who are not members of the organizer. We would like to have judges, scramblers, and runners on staff on the day of the event. We will inform you about the recruitment of staff on the day of the event at a later date. ### About TSC, the host organization Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as "TSC") holds "TSC Space," an off-line meeting for speedcubers, and "TSC Space Study Room," a place for self-improvement for speedcubers. We are currently looking for an administrative staff member. Let's organize WCA competitions and TSC space together!

items.information: ## COVID-19の感染再拡大に伴って首都圏を中心とする緊急事態宣言が延長され、本大会の開催日である8月28日が対象期間となったため、Tokai Summer AM 2021および Tokai Summer PM 2021の開催を中止いたします。 **東海夏AM2021 (以下、AM大会) と東海夏PM2021 (以下、PM大会) は 、WCA Competition Requirements Policy で定められているところの「Twin Competitions」となります。** このため、いずれかの大会の申込みのみが承認されます。 両方に申込んだ場合は、申込日時が早い方を受理し、申込日時が遅い方は無効とします。悪しからずご了承ください。 なお、AM大会とPM大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 * AM大会は、3x3x3 キューブと 2x2x2 キューブの2種目です。 * PM大会は、3x3x3 キューブの1種目のみです。 COVID-19対策のため、入場者数を制限します。**事前承認のない見学はお断りします。**見学を希望の場合、実行委員会宛にメールを送ってください。 ____ ## Due to the re-expansion of COVID-19 infection, the state of emergency centered on the Tokyo metropolitan area was extended, and the target period was August 28, the date of this tournament, so Tokai Summer AM 2021 and Tokai Summer PM 2021 Will be canceled. **Tokai Summer AM 2021 (AM) and Tokai Summer PM 2021 (PM) are "Twin Competitions" defined in the WCA Competition Requirements Policy.** Therefore, you can register either of these competitions. If you register for both competitions, the earlier one will only be recieved, and the later one will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for AM and PM are different. * AM event holds the 3x3x3 cube and the 2x2x2 cube. * PM holds only one event, the 3x3x3 cube. The number of persons in the venue is controlled as COVID-19 countermeasure. If you are not a competitor or their guest and that you want to observe the competition, **please be sure to email the organization team in advance.** or we will not permit your entrance.!

items.information: ### コンセプト スピードキュービングチャレンジでは、できるだけ多くの方々に自己記録更新へと"チャレンジ"していただくことを目指しています。 昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。 この状況を緩和するため、1種目1ラウンドのみでシリーズ大会を開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。 #### **BLD I大会の開催種目は 3x3x3 目隠し (1ラウンド) のみです。通常の 3x3x3 キューブ の競技はありません。同日開催のIV大会かV大会にお申し込みください。** ### WCAシリーズ大会 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 Tokyo Challenge BLD I 2023(**本大会 / 以下、BLD I大会**) 、[Tokyo Challenge IV 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeIV2023)(**以下、IV大会**) 及び[Tokyo Challenge V 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeV2023)(**以下、V大会**) はWCA シリーズ大会です。 BLD I大会、IV大会およびV大会のうち１つの大会だけに参加できます。 ### 競技参加者以外の来場要件 **限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。** 当日飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 **未成年の競技者に対する保護者同伴は、1名とさせていただきます(無料)。18歳以上の競技者は、同伴者なしで来場いただくよう、ご協力をお願いいたします。** もし追加で同伴者として来場する必要がある場合は、見学者としてお申し込みください。(1000円/1人) また、会場内の人数制限のため、見学をお断りする場合がございます。あらかじめご了承ください。 ### サポーター募集 より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。 後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。 ### Concept Speed Cubing Challenge aims to "challenge" as many people as possible to break their own records. In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them. To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions with only one event, one round. #### **The BLD I competitions are held in 3x3x3 blindfold only (1 round). There will be no regular 3x3x3 Cube competition. Please register for the IV or V competitions held on the same day.** ### WCA Series Competitions WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can **only** participate in one of them. If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be accepted, and the others will be invalid. Tokyo Challenge BLD I 2023 (**This Competition / hereinafter referred to as "Competition BLD I"**), [Tokyo Challenge IV 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeIV2023) (**Competition IV**) and [Tokyo Challenge V 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeV2023) (**Competition V**) are WCA series competitions. You can participate in only one of the BLD I, IV and V competitions. ### Requirements for non-competitors **Space is limited in the venue and our priority is allowing as many competitors as possible to compete within our limited venue space.** It is not possible to watch the competition on the day of the event. **Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest. Competitors over the age of 18 are encouraged to come without a guest.** If you need additional guest, please register as a visitor. (1,000 yen per visitors) Please note that due to the limited number of people in the venue, visitors may not be allowed to visit. ### Supporters Wanted In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions. We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

items.information: ### コンセプト スピードキュービングチャレンジでは、できるだけ多くの方々に自己記録更新へと"チャレンジ"していただくことを目指しています。 昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。 この状況を緩和するため、1種目1ラウンドのみでシリーズ大会を開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。 ### WCAシリーズ大会 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 Tokyo Challenge V 2023(**本大会 / 以下、V大会**)、[Tokyo Challenge BLD I 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeBLDI2023) (**以下、BLD I大会**) 及び[Tokyo Challenge IV 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeIV2023)(**以下、IV大会**) はWCA シリーズ大会です。 BLD I大会、IV大会およびV大会のうち１つの大会だけに参加できます。 ### 競技参加者以外の来場要件 **限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。** 当日飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 **未成年の競技者に対する保護者同伴は、1名とさせていただきます(無料)。18歳以上の競技者は、同伴者なしで来場いただくよう、ご協力をお願いいたします。** もし追加で同伴者として来場する必要がある場合は、見学者としてお申し込みください。(1000円/1人) また、会場内の人数制限のため、見学をお断りする場合がございます。あらかじめご了承ください。 ### サポーター募集 より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。 後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。 ### Concept Speed Cubing Challenge aims to "challenge" as many people as possible to break their own records. In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them. To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions in different regions at the same time. ### WCA Series Competitions WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can** only** participate in one of them. If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be accepted, and the others will be invalid. Tokyo Challenge V 2023 **(This Competition / hereinafter referred to as Competition V**) ,[Tokyo Challenge BLD I 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeBLDI2023) (**Competition BLD I**) and [Tokyo Challenge IV 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeIV2023) **(Competition IV**) are WCA series competitions. You can participate in only one of the BLD I, IV and V competitions. ### Requirements for non-competitors **Space is limited in the venue and our priority is allowing as many competitors as possible to compete within our limited venue space.** It is not possible to watch the competition on the day of the event. **Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest. Competitors over the age of 18 are encouraged to come without a guest.** If you need additional guest, please register as a visitor. (1,000 yen per visitors) Please note that due to the limited number of people in the venue, visitors may not be allowed to visit. ### Supporters Wanted In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions. We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

items.information: ### コンセプト スピードキュービングチャレンジでは、できるだけ多くの方々に自己記録更新へと"チャレンジ"していただくことを目指しています。 **開催種目はいずれも3x3x3 キューブ (1ラウンド) のみです。** 昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。 この状況を緩和するため、異なる地域で複数のWCA大会を同時開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。 Go x Go Kyoto 2023、 Tokyo Challenge Winter A/B/C 2023のうち、ご都合の良いもの１つに申し込んでください。 ### WCAシリーズ大会 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち一つにのみ参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 Tokyo Challenge Winter A 2023(**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) 、Tokyo Challenge Winter B 2023(**以下、B大会**) (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeWinterB2023) 及びTokyo Challenge Winter C 2023(**以下、C大会**) (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeWinterC2023) はWCA シリーズ大会です。 A大会、B大会およびC大会のうち１つの大会だけに参加できます。 ### 競技参加者以外の来場要件 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 当日飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場面積の制限、および感染症拡大防止のため同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。 未成年（18歳以下）及び配慮が必要な競技者一人につき一名の同伴者にご来場していただけます（無料）。 上記の同伴者以外の方で会場に来て見学されたい方（以下「見学者」）は有料（1,000円）となります。また会場の広さの都合上、見学者の入場を制限させていただく場合があります（原則として見学者は申し込み順で受け付けています。申し込み制限人数に達した場合は見学をお断りします。） ### サポーター募集 より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。 後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。 ### Concept Speed Cubing Challenge aims to "challenge" as many people as possible to break their own records. **All events are 3x3x3 cube (1 round) only.** In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them. To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions in different regions at the same time. Please register for one of Go x Go Kyoto 2023 or Tokyo Challenge Winter A/B/C 2023, whichever is most convenient for you. ### WCA Series Competitions WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can only participate in one of them. If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be accepted, and the others will be invalid. Tokyo Challenge Winter A 2023 (**This Competition / hereinafter referred to as "Competition A**"), Tokyo Challenge Winter B 2023 (**Competition B**) (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeWinterB2023) and Tokyo Challenge Winter C 2023 (**Competition C**) (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeWinterC2023) are WCA series competitions. You can participate in only one of the A, B and C competitions. ### Requirements for non-competitors Due to the new coronavirus infection (COVID-19) control measures, the number of visitors to the venue will be limited. No one will be allowed to enter the venue on the day of the event without any prior permission. Due to the limited area of the venue and to prevent the spread of infectious diseases, there are restrictions on the number of accompanying persons and observers. One accompanying person is allowed for each competitor who is a minor (18 years old or younger) or requires special consideration (free of charge). Visitors other than the above-mentioned accompanying persons who wish to come and observe the event (hereinafter referred to as "visitors") will be charged a fee (1,000 yen). Due to the size of the venue, admission to visitors may be limited (in principle, visitors are accepted in the order of application. If the number of applicants reaches the limit, no visitors will be allowed.) ### Supporters Wanted In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions. We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

items.information: * This is not your normal competition. If you have not competed before, you are welcome to attend, but this is not the best competition for your first experience. The competition is open to spectators at no charge. * Please be quiet. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund. * Competitors should expect to judge. Depending on the number of competitors who enter and the expected times per BLD attempt, the organisation team will schedule everyone's individual BLD attempts to give the competition a nice, clear structure. When you are not scheduled to compete (this includes FMCers), please be available to judge BLD attempts. IMPORTANT! In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate. For further information, please send an email to [Wilson Alvis](mailto:walvisc54@gmail.com).

venue.name: Ontario Institute for Studies in Education
venue.address: 252 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1V6

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## FMC Canada 2025 We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC Canada 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**. ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Toros Open 2023

venue.name: Instituto Tecnológico de Apizaco
venue.address: Av. Instituto Tecnologico No. 418, San Andrés Ahuashuatepec, Municipio de Tzompantepec, Tlaxcala, Mex.

items.information: Por primera vez en la ciudad de **Apizaco**, ubicada en el conocido estado de **Tlaxcala**, se llevara acabo la competencia oficial **Toros Open 2023**, dentro de las instalaciones del [Instituto Tecnologico de Apizaco](https://www.apizaco.tecnm.mx) y el cual es organizado por alumnos del mismo plantel. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociacion Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0E0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1472683433498f323b318a486650524ce755bc61/Mesa%20de%20trabajo%202Logo%20Toros%20Open%20v2.jpg) For the first time in the city of **Apizaco**, located in the beautiful state of **Tlaxcala**, the first official competition **Toros Open 2023** will take place in the installations of the [InstitutoTecnologico de Apizaco](https://www.apizaco.tecnm.mx) and is organized by the students of the institute. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # 멀티 블라인드: 전체 참가자 중 선착순 50%만 가능 # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80103-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다. WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80100-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80099-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # MBLD: First 50% of registrants only. # There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80103-spectator-limit). If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80100-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80099-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQ1NTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c770014c6db789e76c32778326e0f6980f437a47/466472712_1925266651296844_7482586112726949324_n.jpg) Το Trikala Open 2025 θα είναι o πρωτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 στην πανέμορφη και υπερσύγχρονη πόλη των Τρικάλων! Στο αμφιθεατρικά χτισμένο ξενοδοχείο Ananti Resort & Spa, σε αίθουσα με πανοραμική θέα στην πόλη, θα διαγωνιστούν για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Trikala Open 2025 will be the first official competition in Greece for 2025, held in the beautiful and ultra-modern city of Trikala! At the amphitheatrically built Ananti Resort & Spa, in a hall with panoramic views of the city, Cubers of all ages and skill levels, both newcomers and veterans, from across the country and beyond, will compete for two days. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for yet another celebration of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: **[FR]** **Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.** Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**. Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA. Note : **un (1) accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir. Note : Dans le cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA annule la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs. **[EN]** **As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. Also, a welcome questionnaire will have to be filled, see the [Vaccination proof tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) for more details. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the government updates its regulations.** Moreover, note that **individuals arriving from outside of Canada need to qualify as [fully vaccinated travellers](https://travel.gc.ca/travel-covid/travel-restrictions/covid-vaccinated-travellers-entering-canada) and follow the canadian government policies detailed on the website.** Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new conditions** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing). Note: **Only one (1) spectator per competitor** can attend. **If you're not a competitor or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in and cancel the competition. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

items.information: ##**[FR]** Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement au-delà de la date de fin des inscriptions**. Si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer rapidement, afin de laisser la chance à quelqu'un d'autre de participer. Vous serez remboursé si vous êtes toujours sur la liste d'attente à la fin de la période d'inscription. Lisez attentivement, ci-bas, toutes les conditions d'inscription avant de vous inscrire. *Si vous étudiez au Cégep Trois-Rivières, écrivez votre numéro matricule dans les commentaires de votre inscription*. Le déroulement de la compétition pourra vous paraître lent, car certaines limites de temps sont élevées. Consultez les autres onglets pour des informations additionnelles très importantes sur la compétition. *Note : Certains textes dans ce site web sont en anglais uniquement. Veuillez nous en excuser car les organisateurs ne peuvent faire autrement en utilisant ce site web*. ###**Avis de droit à l'image** Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leur image soit utilisée par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et sur d'autres plateformes numériques. ##**[EN]** There will be **no refunds after the registration period closes**. If you register and you are not able to come, please let us know as soon as possible to let someone else have a chance to participate. You will be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the registration period closes. Please read all the terms and conditions below carefully before registering. *If you study at Cégep Trois-Rivières, please enter your matricule number in the comments of your registration*. The pace of the competition may seem slow to you, as some time limits are high. See the other tabs for very important additional information about the competition. ###**Notice of Filming and Photography** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their image being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: Welcome to this blind events only competition in Tullinge, just outside Stockholm! We will only have blindsolving events at this competition. However, registration is free and the time-limits are lenient, so we would like to see many of you gathered for this competition in April! Please read through all the tabs on this page to get all the information you need for this competition. The main event of this competition is **3x3x3 Blindfolded**. If you have any further questions, feel free to contact the organizers using the contact information on this page. We are not allowed to wear outside shoes inside the venue, and the floor tend to get a bit cold as it is in a basement. Therefore, a good tip is to bring some slippers or inside shoes to keep your feet warm during the day. ----- Varmt välkomna till denna tävling med bara blindgrenar i Tullinge, strax utanför Stockholm! Vi kommer bara ha blindgrenar på denna tävling. Det är dock gratis att delta och alla time-limits är generöst satta, så vi hoppas se många av er på denna tävling i april! Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att få all information om denna tävling. Tävlingens huvudgren är **3x3x3 med Ögonbindel** Om du har ytterligare frågor så går det bra att kontakta arrangörerna genom kontaktinformationen på denna sida. Det är inte tillåtet att ha på sig utomhusskor inne i tävlingslokalen och golvet tenderar och bli ganska kallt då lokalen ligger i en källare. Därför är ett bra tips att ta med er ett par innetofflor eller inomhusskor för att hålla era fötter varma under tävlingen.

items.name: UBC Side Events 2022
items.information: * **Regular 3x3 will not be held at this competition**. * If you are **not** competing in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind in the morning then you do **not** need to show up until after lunch (but coming anyway to help out would be appreciated). * All competitors will be **expected to help out** in order for the event to run smoothly. * Cutoffs, advancement conditions, and event start times may change depending on registration totals - any changes will be emailed out to registered competitors in advance. ###As per UBC's rules, masks will be required at this competition. However, due to the recent changes to BC Public Health Order, we will not be seeking the proof of vaccination status of competitors and guests. As an expected and still valuable courtesy, we simply ask that those experiencing any COVID-19 like symptoms or those with a recent positive COVID-19 test refrain from attending. Competitors may arrange with the organisational team for a full refund if they need to opt out due to the onset of illness or a positive test. Naturally we have a COVID-19 Information tab here on the website to share any useful considerations pertaining to personal wellness at the competition and as a place to communicate any additional changes to the new health order - if the government re-introduces restrictions such as proof of vaccination, we will update the website and email registered competitiors. Registration with a $22 CDN payment through Stripe opens Friday May 13th 5:00pm PDT. Note that registration will close two weeks later. No on the spot registrations will be accepted. Registration is first come, first served based on the order of when payment through Stripe is received. A waitlist will be maintained for those unable to secure a spot in the competition. BY REGISTERING, YOU AGREE THAT YOU UNDERSTAND AND WILL FOLLOW ALL OF THE HEALTH AND SAFETY MEASURES LISTED IN THE HEALTH AND SAFETY (COVID) TAB AND ACCEPT THAT ANY OF THE MEASURES MAY NEED TO BE CHANGED CLOSER TO THE DATE OF THE COMPETITION. Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we require that each competitor bring at most 1 guest.

items.information: UC Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. This competition will utilize dual rounds, meaning that all competitors will advance to the second round of each event, and the winner/ranking of each event will be determined by the best result of each competitor across the two rounds. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0JPIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--09f328966024b349b182c10e5943a3983f83b9cd/snz_logo_v06.png) [Website](https://speedcubing.nz) | [Facebook](https://facebook.com/speedcubingnz) | [Instagram](https://instagram.com/speedcubingnz)

items.information: **¡Formá parte de este nuevo torneo!** Recordá que para participar es obligatorio estar familiarizado con el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) ¡Te necesitamos para seguir fortaleciendo nuestra comunidad! Involucrate con las diferentes tareas que nos ayudan a un torneo exitoso y agradable para todos, ya sea como juez, runner, scrambler, etc. Te dejamos links para más información a continuación: *[Reglas basicas sobre cómo competir](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8O_iWRGq4K8) *[Manual WCA para competidores](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/es/tutorial.pdf) *[Manual WCA para jueces](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/judge-tutorial/judge-tutorial-es.pdf) Te esperamos :) **Be part of this new tournament!** Remember that to participate it is mandatory to be familiar with the ["WCA Regulations"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) We need you to continue strengthening our community! Get involved with the different tasks that help us to have a successful and enjoyable tournament for everyone, be it as a judge, runner, scrambler, etc. We leave you links for more information below: *[Basics rules to compete](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) *[WCA competitor tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) *[WCA judging tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/judge-tutorial/judge-tutorial.pdf) See you there :) CLUB DE SPEEDCUBING PARAGUAY Email: speedcubingpy@gmail.com Facebook: [/cscpy](https://web.facebook.com/cscpy/) Instagram: [@cscpy](https://www.instagram.com/cscpy/)

items.information: # The date of this competition has been moved to March 13th. Please refer to the email sent by the organization team for any concerns. ### This competition is on a weekday! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWeeknightsV2025#53470-competitor-responsibilities-faq) tab. **Spectators can attend for free** and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

items.information: * The competition will take place over two days at UC San Diego's [Price Center](http://universitycenters.ucsd.edu/documents/UCen_PCFloorPlanBW.pdf). * Saturday's events will be held on the 2nd floor in Ballroom West **A**. * Sunday's events will be held in Ballroom West **B**. * Spectating is free and open to the public. Photography and videography are permitted, however there shall be **NO FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY**. * Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years - thanks! * If any changes are made to the competition or schedule, they will be clearly announced to all competitors in an email * **Schedule is tentative to change at the discretion of the organization team** * Although this is completely optional, we ask all competitors to consider [volunteering](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWinter2019#7665-volunteering) to judge, scramble, or run so the competition runs smoothly.

venue.details: Tendrá lugar en la sala de estudio del primer piso de edificio. Cuenta con estacionamientos y metro cerca.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYzMTIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--77b92cc72863445569af65c368f89eb5010927d0/CUBO_colores.png) Bienvenido a UC al Cubo! La primera competencia oficial de speedcubing en la Universidad Católica. Nos encontraremos en un espacio de sana competencia y autosuperación en la sala de estudio del primer piso del edificio Felipe Villanueva, en la Facultad de Matemáticas ubicada en el Campus San Joaquín UC, en la comuna de Macul. Welcome to UC al Cubo! The first official speedcubing competition at Universidad Católica. We will meet in a space of healthy competition and self-improvement in the study room on the first floor of the Felipe Villanueva building, in the Faculty of Mathematics located on the San Joaquín UC Campus, in the commune of Macul.
